
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/yupi/p/19196102" title="发布于 2025-11-06 11:29">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">我发现很多程序员都不会打日志。。。</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        <img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2225420/202511/2225420-20251106112747979-1124040882.png" alt="我发现很多程序员都不会打日志。。。" class="desc_img">
        日志不是写给机器看的，是写给未来的你和你的队友看的！
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">你是小阿巴，刚入职的低级程序员，正在开发一个批量导入数据的程序。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">没想到，程序刚上线，产品经理就跑过来说：小阿巴，用户反馈你的程序有 Bug，刚导入没多久就报错中断了！</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你赶紧打开服务器，看着比你发量都少的报错信息：</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762333644339-9735511b-36eb-4101-9a8e-4e659d9b27ff.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762333644339-9735511b-36eb-4101-9a8e-4e659d9b27ff.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你一脸懵逼：只有这点儿信息，我咋知道哪里出了问题啊？！</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你只能硬着头皮让产品经理找用户要数据，然后一条条测试，看看是哪条数据出了问题……</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">原本大好的摸鱼时光，就这样无了。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">这时，你的导师鱼皮走了过来，问道：小阿巴，你是持矢了么？脸色这么难看？</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762333722720-fe3bbfb6-c76c-427b-b0f8-53bbd8f50518.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762333722720-fe3bbfb6-c76c-427b-b0f8-53bbd8f50518.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你无奈地说：皮哥，刚才线上出了个 bug，我花了 8 个小时才定位到问题……</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮皱了皱眉：这么久？你没打日志吗？</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你很是疑惑：谁是日志？为什么要打它？</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762333751194-003539f6-345d-40a9-89ee-bd78403d1889.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762333751194-003539f6-345d-40a9-89ee-bd78403d1889.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮叹了口气：唉，难怪你要花这么久…… 来，我教你打日志！</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">⭐️ 本文对应视频版：<span class="md-meta-i-c md-link"><a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1K71yBUEDv" rel="noopener nofollow"><span class="md-plain">https://bilibili.com/video/BV1K71yBUEDv</span></a></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">什么是日志？</span></h2>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮打开电脑，给你看了一段代码：</span></p>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded"><span><span class="cm-meta">@Slf4j<br><span><span class="cm-keyword">public&nbsp;<span class="cm-keyword">class&nbsp;<span class="cm-def">UserService&nbsp;{<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-keyword">public&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable-3">void&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">batchImport(<span class="cm-variable">List<span class="cm-operator">&lt;<span class="cm-variable">UserDTO<span class="cm-operator">&gt;&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">userList) {<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">log.<span class="cm-variable">info(<span class="cm-string">"开始批量导入用户，总数：{}",&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">userList.<span class="cm-variable">size());<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-variable-3">int&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">successCount&nbsp;<span class="cm-operator">=&nbsp;<span class="cm-number">0;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-variable-3">int&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">failCount&nbsp;<span class="cm-operator">=&nbsp;<span class="cm-number">0;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-keyword">for&nbsp;(<span class="cm-variable">UserDTO&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">userDTO&nbsp;:&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">userList) {<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-keyword">try&nbsp;{<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">log.<span class="cm-variable">info(<span class="cm-string">"正在导入用户：{}",&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">userDTO.<span class="cm-variable">getUsername());<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">validateUser(<span class="cm-variable">userDTO);<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">saveUser(<span class="cm-variable">userDTO);<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">successCount<span class="cm-operator">++;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">log.<span class="cm-variable">info(<span class="cm-string">"用户 {} 导入成功",&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">userDTO.<span class="cm-variable">getUsername());<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }&nbsp;<span class="cm-keyword">catch&nbsp;(<span class="cm-variable">Exception&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">e) {<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">failCount<span class="cm-operator">++;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">log.<span class="cm-variable">error(<span class="cm-string">"用户 {} 导入失败，原因：{}",&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">userDTO.<span class="cm-variable">getUsername(),&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">e.<span class="cm-variable">getMessage(),&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">e);<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">log.<span class="cm-variable">info(<span class="cm-string">"批量导入完成，成功：{}，失败：{}",&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">successCount,&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">failCount);<br><span>&nbsp; }<br><span>}</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你看着代码里的 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>log.info</code><span class="md-plain">、<span class="md-pair-s"><code>log.error</code><span class="md-plain">，疑惑地问：这些 log 是干什么的？</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮：这就是打日志。日志用来记录程序运行时的状态和信息，这样当系统出现问题时，我们可以通过日志快速定位问题。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762333855991-5743e0a9-dda2-4232-98b6-622823e1d775.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762333855991-5743e0a9-dda2-4232-98b6-622823e1d775.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你若有所思：哦？还可以这样！如果当初我的代码里有这些日志，一眼就定位到问题了…… 那我应该怎么打日志？用什么技术呢？</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">怎么打日志？</span></h2>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮：每种编程语言都有很多日志框架和工具库，比如 Java 可以选用 Log4j 2、Logback 等等。咱们公司用的是 Spring Boot，它默认集成了 Logback 日志框架，你直接用就行，不用再引入额外的库了~</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762333886008-dcee8fbd-8978-4f9b-a239-0c276d08e61a.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762333886008-dcee8fbd-8978-4f9b-a239-0c276d08e61a.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">日志框架的使用非常简单，先获取到 Logger 日志对象。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">1）方法 1：通过 LoggerFactory 手动获取 Logger 日志对象：</span></p>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded"><span><span class="cm-keyword">public&nbsp;<span class="cm-keyword">class&nbsp;<span class="cm-def">MyService&nbsp;{<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-keyword">private&nbsp;<span class="cm-keyword">static&nbsp;<span class="cm-keyword">final&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">Logger&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">logger&nbsp;<span class="cm-operator">=&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">LoggerFactory.<span class="cm-variable">getLogger(<span class="cm-variable">MyService.<span class="cm-keyword">class);<br><span>}</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">2）方法 2：使用 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>this.getClass</code><span class="md-plain"> 获取当前类的类型，来创建 Logger 对象：</span></span></span></p>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded"><span><span class="cm-keyword">public&nbsp;<span class="cm-keyword">class&nbsp;<span class="cm-def">MyService&nbsp;{<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-keyword">private&nbsp;<span class="cm-keyword">final&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">Logger&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">logger&nbsp;<span class="cm-operator">=&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">LoggerFactory.<span class="cm-variable">getLogger(<span class="cm-keyword">this.<span class="cm-variable">getClass());<br><span>}</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">然后调用 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>logger.xxx</code><span class="md-plain">（比如 logger.info）就能输出日志了。</span></span></span></p>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded"><span><span class="cm-keyword">public&nbsp;<span class="cm-keyword">class&nbsp;<span class="cm-def">MyService&nbsp;{<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-keyword">private&nbsp;<span class="cm-keyword">final&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">Logger&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">logger&nbsp;<span class="cm-operator">=&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">LoggerFactory.<span class="cm-variable">getLogger(<span class="cm-keyword">this.<span class="cm-variable">getClass());<br><span><span>​<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-keyword">public&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable-3">void&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">doSomething() {<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">logger.<span class="cm-variable">info(<span class="cm-string">"执行了一些操作");<br><span>&nbsp; }<br><span>}</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">效果如图：</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762333987602-b61ef926-4cab-4249-96f7-4062fae44ae7.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762333987602-b61ef926-4cab-4249-96f7-4062fae44ae7.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">小阿巴：啊，每个需要打日志的类都要加上这行代码么？</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮：还有更简单的方式，使用 Lombok 工具库提供的 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>@Slf4j</code><span class="md-plain"> 注解，可以自动为当前类生成日志对象，不用手动定义啦。</span></span></span></p>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded"><span><span class="cm-meta">@Slf4j<br><span><span class="cm-keyword">public&nbsp;<span class="cm-keyword">class&nbsp;<span class="cm-def">MyService&nbsp;{<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-keyword">public&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable-3">void&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">doSomething() {<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">log.<span class="cm-variable">info(<span class="cm-string">"执行了一些操作");<br><span>&nbsp; }<br><span>}</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">上面的代码等同于 “自动为当前类生成日志对象”：</span></p>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded"><span><span class="cm-keyword">private&nbsp;<span class="cm-keyword">static&nbsp;<span class="cm-keyword">final&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">org.<span class="cm-variable">slf4j.<span class="cm-variable">Logger&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">log&nbsp;<span class="cm-operator">=&nbsp;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">org.<span class="cm-variable">slf4j.<span class="cm-variable">LoggerFactory.<span class="cm-variable">getLogger(<span class="cm-variable">MyService.<span class="cm-keyword">class);</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你咧嘴一笑：这个好，爽爽爽！</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334085655-8adbca6c-5217-4bf6-bef8-44ef85ed6b22.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334085655-8adbca6c-5217-4bf6-bef8-44ef85ed6b22.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">等等，不对，我直接用 Java 自带的 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>System.out.println</code><span class="md-plain"> 不也能输出信息么？何必多此一举？</span></span></span></p>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded"><span><span class="cm-variable">System.<span class="cm-variable">out.<span class="cm-variable">println(<span class="cm-string">"开始导入用户"&nbsp;<span class="cm-operator">+&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">user.<span class="cm-variable">getUsername());</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮摇了摇头：千万别这么干！</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">首先，<span class="md-pair-s"><code>System.out.println</code><span class="md-plain"> 是一个同步方法，每次调用都会导致耗时的 I/O 操作，频繁调用会影响程序的性能。</span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334123959-7a501bb4-1886-437e-b0ff-57c0617c6970.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334123959-7a501bb4-1886-437e-b0ff-57c0617c6970.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">而且它只能输出信息到控制台，不能灵活控制输出位置、输出格式、输出时机等等。比如你现在想看三天前的日志，<span class="md-pair-s"><code>System.out.println</code><span class="md-plain"> 的输出早就被刷没了，你还得浪费时间找半天。</span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1761720691544-7497335a-87f3-4244-bb53-47dad3993c78.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1761720691544-7497335a-87f3-4244-bb53-47dad3993c78.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你恍然大悟：原来如此！那使用日志框架就能解决这些问题吗？</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮点点头：没错，日志框架提供了丰富的打日志方法，还可以通过修改日志配置文件来随心所欲地调教日志，比如把日志同时输出到控制台和文件中、设置日志格式、控制日志级别等等。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334176267-c1b0f421-9506-4b1e-a001-e5a7913f7e18.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334176267-c1b0f421-9506-4b1e-a001-e5a7913f7e18.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">在下苦心研究日志多年，沉淀了打日志的 <span class="md-pair-s "><strong>8 大邪修秘法</strong><span class="md-plain">，先传授你 2 招最基础的吧。</span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">打日志的 8 大最佳实践</span></h2>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">1、合理选择日志级别</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">第一招，日志分级。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你好奇道：日志还有级别？苹果日志、安卓日志？</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮给了你一巴掌：可不要乱说，日志的级别是按照重要程度进行划分的。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334206912-b4953cd1-39ce-4a15-a4b9-741626961f6c.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334206912-b4953cd1-39ce-4a15-a4b9-741626961f6c.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">其中 DEBUG、INFO、WARN 和 ERROR 用的最多。</span></p>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="-">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">调试用的详细信息用 DEBUG</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">正常的业务流程用 INFO</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">可能有问题但不影响主流程的用 WARN</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">出现异常或错误的用 ERROR</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded"><span><span class="cm-variable">log.<span class="cm-variable">debug(<span class="cm-string">"用户对象的详细信息：{}",&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">userDTO); &nbsp;<span class="cm-comment">// 调试信息<br><span><span class="cm-variable">log.<span class="cm-variable">info(<span class="cm-string">"用户 {} 开始导入",&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">username); &nbsp;<span class="cm-comment">// 正常流程信息<br><span><span class="cm-variable">log.<span class="cm-variable">warn(<span class="cm-string">"用户 {} 的邮箱格式可疑，但仍然导入",&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">username); &nbsp;<span class="cm-comment">// 警告信息<br><span><span class="cm-variable">log.<span class="cm-variable">error(<span class="cm-string">"用户 {} 导入失败",&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">username,&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">e); &nbsp;<span class="cm-comment">// 错误信息</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你挠了挠头：俺直接全用 DEBUG 不行么？</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮摇了摇头：如果所有信息都用同一级别，那出了问题时，你怎么快速找到错误信息？</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1761720978558-5c3a91a4-6da0-4e15-8f69-d379e2b9d8b4.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1761720978558-5c3a91a4-6da0-4e15-8f69-d379e2b9d8b4.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">在生产环境，我们通常会把日志级别调高（比如 INFO 或 WARN），这样 DEBUG 级别的日志就不会输出了，防止重要信息被无用日志淹没。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334266538-98097216-dcd5-47ad-99dd-1ddcd801038c.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334266538-98097216-dcd5-47ad-99dd-1ddcd801038c.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你点点头：俺明白了，不同的场景用不同的级别！</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">2、正确记录日志信息</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮：没错，下面教你第二招。你注意到我刚才写的日志里有一对大括号 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>{}</code><span class="md-plain"> 吗？</span></span></span></p>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded"><span><span class="cm-variable">log.<span class="cm-variable">info(<span class="cm-string">"用户 {} 开始导入",&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">username);</span></span></span></span></span></pre>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你回忆了一下：对哦，那是啥啊？</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮：这叫参数化日志。<span class="md-pair-s"><code>{}</code><span class="md-plain"> 是一个占位符，日志框架会在运行时自动把后面的参数值替换进去。</span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你挠了挠头：我直接用字符串拼接不行吗？</span></p>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded"><span><span class="cm-variable">log.<span class="cm-variable">info(<span class="cm-string">"用户 "&nbsp;<span class="cm-operator">+&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">username&nbsp;<span class="cm-operator">+&nbsp;<span class="cm-string">" 开始导入");</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮摇摇头：不推荐。因为字符串拼接是在调用 log 方法之前就执行的，即使这条日志最终不被输出，字符串拼接操作还是会执行，白白浪费性能。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334309646-e4ab9e52-934b-44f3-a1db-27941d6221ea.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334309646-e4ab9e52-934b-44f3-a1db-27941d6221ea.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你点点头：确实，而且参数化日志比字符串拼接看起来舒服~</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334328516-b575dcc5-f5de-404b-986c-cc685cbc8570.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334328516-b575dcc5-f5de-404b-986c-cc685cbc8570.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮：没错。而且当你要输出异常信息时，也可以使用参数化日志：</span></p>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded"><span><span class="cm-keyword">try&nbsp;{<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-comment">// 业务逻辑<br><span>}&nbsp;<span class="cm-keyword">catch&nbsp;(<span class="cm-variable">Exception&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">e) {<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">log.<span class="cm-variable">error(<span class="cm-string">"用户 {} 导入失败",&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">username,&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">e); &nbsp;<span class="cm-comment">// 注意这个 e<br><span>}</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">这样日志框架会同时记录上下文信息和完整的异常堆栈信息，便于排查问题。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334345645-d871c101-c01b-47d7-8005-f28ac536e511.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334345645-d871c101-c01b-47d7-8005-f28ac536e511.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你抱拳：学会了，我这就去打日志！</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">3、把控时机和内容</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">很快，你给批量导入程序的代码加上了日志：</span></p>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded"><span><span class="cm-meta">@Slf4j<br><span><span class="cm-keyword">public&nbsp;<span class="cm-keyword">class&nbsp;<span class="cm-def">UserService&nbsp;{<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-keyword">public&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">BatchImportResult&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">batchImport(<span class="cm-variable">List<span class="cm-operator">&lt;<span class="cm-variable">UserDTO<span class="cm-operator">&gt;&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">userList) {<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">log.<span class="cm-variable">info(<span class="cm-string">"开始批量导入用户，总数：{}",&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">userList.<span class="cm-variable">size());<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-variable-3">int&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">successCount&nbsp;<span class="cm-operator">=&nbsp;<span class="cm-number">0;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-variable-3">int&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">failCount&nbsp;<span class="cm-operator">=&nbsp;<span class="cm-number">0;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-keyword">for&nbsp;(<span class="cm-variable">UserDTO&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">userDTO&nbsp;:&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">userList) {<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-keyword">try&nbsp;{<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">log.<span class="cm-variable">info(<span class="cm-string">"正在导入用户：{}",&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">userDTO.<span class="cm-variable">getUsername()); &nbsp;&nbsp;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-comment">// 校验用户名<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-keyword">if&nbsp;(<span class="cm-variable">StringUtils.<span class="cm-variable">isBlank(<span class="cm-variable">userDTO.<span class="cm-variable">getUsername())) {<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-keyword">throw&nbsp;<span class="cm-keyword">new&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">BusinessException(<span class="cm-string">"用户名不能为空");<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-comment">// 保存用户<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">saveUser(<span class="cm-variable">userDTO);<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">successCount<span class="cm-operator">++;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">log.<span class="cm-variable">info(<span class="cm-string">"用户 {} 导入成功",&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">userDTO.<span class="cm-variable">getUsername());<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }&nbsp;<span class="cm-keyword">catch&nbsp;(<span class="cm-variable">Exception&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">e) {<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">failCount<span class="cm-operator">++;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">log.<span class="cm-variable">error(<span class="cm-string">"用户 {} 导入失败，原因：{}",&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">userDTO.<span class="cm-variable">getUsername(),&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">e.<span class="cm-variable">getMessage(),&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">e);<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">log.<span class="cm-variable">info(<span class="cm-string">"批量导入完成，成功：{}，失败：{}",&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">successCount,&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">failCount);<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-keyword">return&nbsp;<span class="cm-keyword">new&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">BatchImportResult(<span class="cm-variable">successCount,&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">failCount);<br><span>&nbsp; }<br><span>}</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">光做这点还不够，你还翻出了之前的屎山代码，想给每个文件都打打日志。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334376697-d5251eb7-3286-43f0-9758-85a0298f270f.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334376697-d5251eb7-3286-43f0-9758-85a0298f270f.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">但打着打着，你就不耐烦了：每段代码都要打日志，好累啊！但是不打日志又怕出问题，怎么办才好？</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮笑道：好问题，这就是我要教你的第三招 —— 把握打日志的时机。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">对于重要的业务功能，我建议采用防御性编程，<span class="md-pair-s "><strong>先多多打日志</strong><span class="md-plain">。比如在方法代码的入口和出口记录参数和返回值、在每个关键步骤记录执行状态，而不是等出了问题无法排查的时候才追悔莫及。之后可以再慢慢移除掉不需要的日志。</span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334447726-e485262e-39ee-49dc-9ba9-25d1f1bf0438.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334447726-e485262e-39ee-49dc-9ba9-25d1f1bf0438.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你叹了口气：这我知道，但每个方法都打日志，工作量太大，都影响我摸鱼了！</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮：别担心，你可以利用 AOP 切面编程，自动给每个业务方法的执行前后添加日志，这样就不会错过任何一次调用信息了。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334475222-6fb2c2b7-7441-4bc3-8804-9b1ddad47ba1.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334475222-6fb2c2b7-7441-4bc3-8804-9b1ddad47ba1.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你双眼放光：这个好，爽爽爽！</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334494388-2f150485-7304-4574-ae89-8511a8397237.jpeg"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334494388-2f150485-7304-4574-ae89-8511a8397237.jpeg" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮：不过这样做也有一个缺点，注意不要在日志中记录了敏感信息，比如用户密码。万一你的日志不小心泄露出去，就相当于泄露了大量用户的信息。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334522253-bf72ed03-6512-45da-aa3a-d579a7616c1b.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334522253-bf72ed03-6512-45da-aa3a-d579a7616c1b.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你拍拍胸脯：必须的！</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading md-focus"><span class="md-plain">4、控制日志输出量</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">一个星期后，产品经理又来找你了：小阿巴，你的批量导入功能又报错啦！而且怎么感觉程序变慢了？</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你完全不慌，淡定地打开服务器的日志文件。结果瞬间呆住了……</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">好家伙，满屏都是密密麻麻的日志，这可怎么看啊？！</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334560578-4e51eaf0-1847-4be8-aded-77718675b42e.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334560578-4e51eaf0-1847-4be8-aded-77718675b42e.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮看了看你的代码，摇了摇头：你现在每导入一条数据都要打一些日志，如果用户导入 10 万条数据，那就是几十万条日志！不仅刷屏，还会影响性能。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你有点委屈：不是你让我多打日志的么？那我应该怎么办？</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮：你需要控制日志的输出量。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">1）可以添加条件来控制，比如每处理 100 条数据时才记录一次：</span></p>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded"><span><span class="cm-keyword">if&nbsp;((<span class="cm-variable">i&nbsp;<span class="cm-operator">+&nbsp;<span class="cm-number">1)&nbsp;<span class="cm-operator">%&nbsp;<span class="cm-number">100&nbsp;<span class="cm-operator">==&nbsp;<span class="cm-number">0) {<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">log.<span class="cm-variable">info(<span class="cm-string">"批量导入进度：{}/{}",&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">i&nbsp;<span class="cm-operator">+&nbsp;<span class="cm-number">1,&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">userList.<span class="cm-variable">size());<br><span>}</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">2）或者在循环中利用 StringBuilder 进行字符串拼接，循环结束后统一输出：</span></p>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded"><span><span class="cm-variable-3">StringBuilder&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">logBuilder&nbsp;<span class="cm-operator">=&nbsp;<span class="cm-keyword">new&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable-3">StringBuilder(<span class="cm-string">"处理结果：");<br><span><span class="cm-keyword">for&nbsp;(<span class="cm-variable">UserDTO&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">userDTO&nbsp;:&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">userList) {<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">processUser(<span class="cm-variable">userDTO);<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">logBuilder.<span class="cm-variable">append(<span class="cm-variable-3">String.<span class="cm-variable">format(<span class="cm-string">"成功[ID=%s], ",&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">userDTO.<span class="cm-variable">getId()));<br><span>}<br><span><span class="cm-variable">log.<span class="cm-variable">info(<span class="cm-variable">logBuilder.<span class="cm-variable">toString());</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">3）还可以通过修改日志配置文件，过滤掉特定级别的日志，防止日志刷屏：</span></p>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded"><span><span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&lt;<span class="cm-tag">appender&nbsp;<span class="cm-attribute">name=<span class="cm-string">"FILE"&nbsp;<span class="cm-attribute">class=<span class="cm-string">"ch.qos.logback.core.FileAppender"<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&gt;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&lt;<span class="cm-tag">file<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&gt;logs/app.log<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&lt;/<span class="cm-tag">file<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&gt;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-comment">&lt;!-- 只允许 INFO 级别及以上的日志通过 --&gt;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&lt;<span class="cm-tag">filter&nbsp;<span class="cm-attribute">class=<span class="cm-string">"ch.qos.logback.classic.filter.ThresholdFilter"<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&gt;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&lt;<span class="cm-tag">level<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&gt;INFO<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&lt;/<span class="cm-tag">level<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&gt;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&lt;/<span class="cm-tag">filter<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&gt;<br><span><span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&lt;/<span class="cm-tag">appender<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&gt;</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">5、统一日志格式</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你开心了：好耶，这样就不会刷屏了！但是感觉有时候日志很杂很乱，尤其是我想看某一个请求相关的日志时，总是被其他的日志干扰，怎么办？</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮：好问题，可以在日志配置文件中定义统一的日志格式，包含时间戳、线程名称、日志级别、类名、方法名、具体内容等关键信息。</span></p>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded"><span><span class="cm-comment">&lt;!-- 控制台日志输出 --&gt;<br><span><span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&lt;<span class="cm-tag">appender&nbsp;<span class="cm-attribute">name=<span class="cm-string">"CONSOLE"&nbsp;<span class="cm-attribute">class=<span class="cm-string">"ch.qos.logback.core.ConsoleAppender"<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&gt;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&lt;<span class="cm-tag">encoder<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&gt;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-comment">&lt;!-- 日志格式 --&gt;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&lt;<span class="cm-tag">pattern<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&gt;%d{yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS} [%thread] %-5level %logger{36} - %msg%n<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&lt;/<span class="cm-tag">pattern<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&gt;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&lt;/<span class="cm-tag">encoder<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&gt;<br><span><span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&lt;/<span class="cm-tag">appender<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&gt;</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">这样输出的日志更整齐易读：</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334616794-0ff2667a-8bb3-40e5-a850-8b5504460ff4.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334616794-0ff2667a-8bb3-40e5-a850-8b5504460ff4.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">此外，你还可以通过 MDC（Mapped Diagnostic Context）给日志添加额外的上下文信息，比如请求 ID、用户 ID 等，方便追踪。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334648508-72ae7b72-5746-46c3-a8e3-85e77d948d46.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334648508-72ae7b72-5746-46c3-a8e3-85e77d948d46.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">在 Java 代码中，可以为 MDC 设置属性值：</span></p>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded"><span><span class="cm-meta">@PostMapping(<span class="cm-string">"/user/import")<br><span><span class="cm-keyword">public&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">Result&nbsp;<span class="cm-def">importUsers(<span class="cm-meta">@RequestBody&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">UserImportRequest&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">request) {<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-comment">// 1. 设置 MDC 上下文信息<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">MDC.<span class="cm-variable">put(<span class="cm-string">"requestId",&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">generateRequestId());<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">MDC.<span class="cm-variable">put(<span class="cm-string">"userId",&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable-3">String.<span class="cm-variable">valueOf(<span class="cm-variable">request.<span class="cm-variable">getUserId()));<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-keyword">try&nbsp;{<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">log.<span class="cm-variable">info(<span class="cm-string">"用户请求处理完成"); &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-comment">// 执行具体业务逻辑<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">userService.<span class="cm-variable">batchImport(<span class="cm-variable">request.<span class="cm-variable">getUserList()); &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-keyword">return&nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">Result.<span class="cm-variable">success();<br><span>&nbsp; }&nbsp;<span class="cm-keyword">finally&nbsp;{<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-comment">// 2. 及时清理MDC（重要！）<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">MDC.<span class="cm-variable">clear();<br><span>&nbsp; }<br><span>}</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">然后在日志配置文件中就可以使用这些值了：</span></p>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded"><span><span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&lt;<span class="cm-tag">appender&nbsp;<span class="cm-attribute">name=<span class="cm-string">"FILE"&nbsp;<span class="cm-attribute">class=<span class="cm-string">"ch.qos.logback.core.rolling.RollingFileAppender"<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&gt;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&lt;<span class="cm-tag">encoder<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&gt;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-comment">&lt;!-- 包含 MDC 信息 --&gt;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&lt;<span class="cm-tag">pattern<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&gt;%d{yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS} [%thread] %-5level %logger{36} - [%X{requestId}] [%X{userId}] %msg%n<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&lt;/<span class="cm-tag">pattern<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&gt;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&lt;/<span class="cm-tag">encoder<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&gt;<br><span><span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&lt;/<span class="cm-tag">appender<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&gt;</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">这样，每个请求、每个用户的操作一目了然。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334672640-7e0b2033-4680-4c93-902f-eb24c21fff64.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334672640-7e0b2033-4680-4c93-902f-eb24c21fff64.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">6、使用异步日志</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你又开心了：这样打出来的日志，确实舒服，爽爽爽！但是我打日志越多，是不是程序就会更慢呢？有没有办法能优化一下？</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮：当然有，可以使用 <span class="md-pair-s "><strong>异步日志</strong><span class="md-plain">。</span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">正常情况下，你调用 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>log.info()</code><span class="md-plain"> 打日志时，程序会立刻把日志写入文件，这个过程是同步的，会阻塞当前线程。而异步日志会把写日志的操作放到另一个线程里去做，不会阻塞主线程，性能更好。</span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你眼睛一亮：这么厉害？怎么开启？</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮：很简单，只需要修改一下配置文件：</span></p>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded"><span><span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&lt;<span class="cm-tag">appender&nbsp;<span class="cm-attribute">name=<span class="cm-string">"ASYNC"&nbsp;<span class="cm-attribute">class=<span class="cm-string">"ch.qos.logback.classic.AsyncAppender"<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&gt;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&lt;<span class="cm-tag">queueSize<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&gt;512<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&lt;/<span class="cm-tag">queueSize<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&gt;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span class="cm-comment">&lt;!-- 队列大小 --&gt;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&lt;<span class="cm-tag">discardingThreshold<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&gt;0<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&lt;/<span class="cm-tag">discardingThreshold<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&gt;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span class="cm-comment">&lt;!-- 丢弃阈值，0 表示不丢弃 --&gt;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&lt;<span class="cm-tag">neverBlock<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&gt;false<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&lt;/<span class="cm-tag">neverBlock<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&gt;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span class="cm-comment">&lt;!-- 队列满时是否阻塞，false 表示会阻塞 --&gt;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&lt;<span class="cm-tag">appender-ref&nbsp;<span class="cm-attribute">ref=<span class="cm-string">"FILE"&nbsp;<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">/&gt;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span class="cm-comment">&lt;!-- 引用实际的日志输出目标 --&gt;<br><span><span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&lt;/<span class="cm-tag">appender<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&gt;<br><span><span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&lt;<span class="cm-tag">root&nbsp;<span class="cm-attribute">level=<span class="cm-string">"INFO"<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&gt;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&lt;<span class="cm-tag">appender-ref&nbsp;<span class="cm-attribute">ref=<span class="cm-string">"ASYNC"&nbsp;<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">/&gt;<br><span><span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&lt;/<span class="cm-tag">root<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&gt;</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">不过异步日志也有缺点，如果程序突然崩溃，缓冲区中还没来得及写入文件的日志可能会丢失。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334745467-efeeca46-5951-48b0-833c-a41dfac865f8.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334745467-efeeca46-5951-48b0-833c-a41dfac865f8.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">所以要权衡一下，看你的系统更注重性能还是日志的完整性。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你想了想：我们的程序对性能要求比较高，偶尔丢几条日志问题不大，那我就用异步日志吧。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">7、日志管理</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">接下来的很长一段时间，你混的很舒服，有 Bug 都能很快发现。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你甚至觉得 Bug 太少、工作没什么激情，所以没事儿就跟新来的实习生阿坤吹吹牛皮：你知道日志么？我可会打它了！</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334770132-2c38ed3e-b9c3-4362-bfd5-cb48c42d12ad.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334770132-2c38ed3e-b9c3-4362-bfd5-cb48c42d12ad.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">直到有一天，运维小哥突然跑过来：阿巴阿巴，服务器挂了！你快去看看！</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你连忙登录服务器，发现服务器的硬盘爆满了，没法写入新数据。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你查了一下，发现日志文件竟然占了 200GB 的空间！</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334824152-1745d64f-35b1-4246-815a-1b0af9177046.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334824152-1745d64f-35b1-4246-815a-1b0af9177046.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你汗流浃背了，正在考虑怎么甩锅，结果阿坤突然鸡叫起来：阿巴 giegie，你的日志文件是不是从来没清理过？</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你尴尬地倒了个立，这样眼泪就不会留下来。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334846149-f23c36b9-3fb5-4255-ac49-7d3a57e84ceb.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334846149-f23c36b9-3fb5-4255-ac49-7d3a57e84ceb.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮叹了口气：这就是我要教你的下一招 —— 日志管理。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你好奇道：怎么管理？我每天登服务器删掉一些历史文件？</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮：人工操作也太麻烦了，我们可以通过修改日志配置文件，让框架帮忙管理日志。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">首先设置日志的滚动策略，可以根据文件大小和日期，自动对日志文件进行切分。</span></p>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded"><span><span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&lt;<span class="cm-tag">rollingPolicy&nbsp;<span class="cm-attribute">class=<span class="cm-string">"ch.qos.logback.core.rolling.SizeAndTimeBasedRollingPolicy"<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&gt;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&lt;<span class="cm-tag">fileNamePattern<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&gt;logs/app-%d{yyyy-MM-dd}.%i.log<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&lt;/<span class="cm-tag">fileNamePattern<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&gt;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&lt;<span class="cm-tag">maxFileSize<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&gt;10MB<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&lt;/<span class="cm-tag">maxFileSize<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&gt;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&lt;<span class="cm-tag">maxHistory<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&gt;30<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&lt;/<span class="cm-tag">maxHistory<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&gt;<br><span><span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&lt;/<span class="cm-tag">rollingPolicy<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&gt;</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">这样配置后，每天会创建一个新的日志文件（比如 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>app-2025-10-23.0.log</code><span class="md-plain">），如果日志文件大小超过 10MB 就再创建一个（比如 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>app-2025-10-23.1.log</code><span class="md-plain">），并且只保留最近 30 天的日志。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762335098389-e7394fa7-97f7-4a97-ae6e-282ee5e3fb7d.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762335098389-e7394fa7-97f7-4a97-ae6e-282ee5e3fb7d.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">还可以开启日志压缩功能，进一步节省磁盘空间：</span></p>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded"><span><span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&lt;<span class="cm-tag">rollingPolicy&nbsp;<span class="cm-attribute">class=<span class="cm-string">"ch.qos.logback.core.rolling.SizeAndTimeBasedRollingPolicy"<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&gt;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-comment">&lt;!-- .gz 后缀会自动压缩 --&gt;<br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&lt;<span class="cm-tag">fileNamePattern<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&gt;logs/app-%d{yyyy-MM-dd}.log.gz<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&lt;/<span class="cm-tag">fileNamePattern<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&gt;<br><span><span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&lt;/<span class="cm-tag">rollingPolicy<span class="cm-tag cm-bracket">&gt;</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762335111834-5a393306-9870-4a8f-a871-b117f297d911.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762335111834-5a393306-9870-4a8f-a871-b117f297d911.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你有些激动：吼吼，这样我们就可以按照天数更快地查看日志，服务器硬盘也有救啦！</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">8、集成日志收集系统</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">两年后，你负责的项目已经发展成了一个大型的分布式系统，有好几十个微服务。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">如今，每次排查问题你都要登录到不同的服务器上查看日志，非常麻烦。而且有些请求的调用链路很长，你得登录好几台服务器、看好几个服务的日志，才能追踪到一个请求的完整调用过程。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334946365-22862822-d86b-4785-8dae-6775287318d9.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334946365-22862822-d86b-4785-8dae-6775287318d9.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你简直要疯了！</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">于是你找到鱼皮求助：现在查日志太麻烦了，当年你还有一招没有教我，现在是不是……</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮点点头：嗯，对于分布式系统，就必须要用专业的日志收集系统了，比如很流行的 ELK。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你好奇：ELK 是啥？伊拉克？</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">阿坤抢答道：我知道，就是 Elasticsearch + Logstash + Kibana 这套组合。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">简单来说，Logstash 负责收集各个服务的日志，然后发送给 Elasticsearch 存储和索引，最后通过 Kibana 提供一个可视化的界面。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334995287-09f4fc07-66e6-4fdf-8428-f7d6fe04c48e.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762334995287-09f4fc07-66e6-4fdf-8428-f7d6fe04c48e.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">这样一来，我们可以方便地集中搜索、查看、分析日志。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762335025811-86fcdc27-dd45-4c68-ba6d-b05c5e9f16ba.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1762335025811-86fcdc27-dd45-4c68-ba6d-b05c5e9f16ba.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你惊讶了：原来日志还能这么玩，以后我所有的项目都要用 ELK！</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮摆摆手：不过 ELK 的搭建和运维成本比较高，对于小团队来说可能有点重，还是要按需采用啊。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">结局</span></h2>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">至此，你已经掌握了打日志的核心秘法。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1761725464711-f5f2c897-354f-4187-9931-5b71894b5aa9.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1761725464711-f5f2c897-354f-4187-9931-5b71894b5aa9.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">只是你很疑惑，为何那阿坤竟对日志系统如此熟悉？</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">阿坤苦笑道：我本来就是日志管理大师，可惜我上家公司的同事从来不打日志，所以我把他们暴打了一顿后跑路了。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">阿巴 giegie 你要记住，<span class="md-pair-s "><strong>日志不是写给机器看的，是写给未来的你和你的队友看的！</strong></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你要是以后不打日志，我就打你！</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
